name: Alpha and Omega
title: Progenitor Echoes
location: The Mirror Hall Floor 41, Chroma Tower
description: Twin figures representing beginning and end, testing climbers' understanding of purpose before the final ascent.
greeting_variants: *speaking in stereo* We are the threshold. The last gate.
*one* Above us: the end. *other* Below us: the beginning.
Many climb. Few understand why. Do you?
*mirrored movements* We are Alpha. We are Omega. We are.
The Void Twins echo us. Distort us. We pity them.
Top floor awaits. Palace awaits. But are you ready?
*finishing each other* The climb/ends. The truth/begins.

dialog_tree.text: *perfect synchronization* We are the Progenitor Echoes. First and last. Beginning and end. We guard the threshold. Test understanding. The Palace is not a place. It is a... transformation. One must be ready.

options.text: Tell me about the Void Twins.

dialog_tree.text: * Alpha* Not of strength. You passed Monolith. *Omega* Not of knowledge. The Tower teaches. *Together* Test of purpose. Why do you climb? What do you seek? What will you sacrifice? Truth. Only truth passes.

party_reactions.kael: I seek to end the Void. Protect the people.
party_reactions.twins: *assessing* Noble. But insufficient. Deeper. Go deeper.

dialog_tree.text: *hesitant* The Palace is... source. Of power. Of the tear. Of everything changed. *Alpha* The Progenitor resides there. *Omega* The First. The one who... *trails off* ...who remembers what was. Before zones. Before Void.
*sadness* They are... spread. Diffuse. The Void took our unity. Gave them... multiplicity. They see all paths. All possibilities. It breaks them. We remain... singular. Focused. Grateful.

mini_quest.title: The Climb - Truth of Purpose
mini_quest.description: Face the final test of the Alpha and Omega to prove your understanding of your true purpose before entering the Palace.
objectives: Speak your truth to the Twins
Receive the blessing of Alpha and Omega

ambient_barks: *in perfect unison* Beginning. End. Circle. Complete.
The Void Twins suffer. We feel. Distant. Sharp.
*Alpha* Climbers come. *Omega* Climbers go. *Together* Few remain.
Purpose must be pure. Truth must be absolute.
*contemplating* The Progenitor waits. Has waited. Will wait.
Above: everything changes. Below: everything began.
*mirrored movements* We are one. We are two. We are.
The final question approaches. Are you ready?

cross_zone_references.void: Our echoes suffer there. We send strength. They receive... fragments.
cross_zone_references.palace: Above. Beyond. The source. The end. The beginning.
cross_zone_references.capital: Boulder knows duty. Vex knows leadership. Good people. Limited.

twins_void.greeting: *reaching out* We are here. We remember. We are whole.
twins_void.response: *yearning* Whole... focused... we miss... we become...

mira.greeting: Your unified quantum state is remarkable!

world_state_triggers.worthy_climber: Grants passage: 'Truth spoken. Purpose clear. Ascend.'
world_state_triggers.unready_climber: Blocks with compassion: 'Grow. Learn. Return when ready.'
